description: The exact x402 402 (price, USDG asset, payTo, network, extensions) for one specific request to an x402Fi endpoint, without paying or calling the paid endpoint. Quoted endpoints are priced for this exact request. Sign the returned `accepts[0]` with the user's own wallet, then send the request with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header (a seller's own v1 endpoint reads X-PAYMENT instead: see `payment_header` in the result).

body.description: JSON body for POST/PUT/PATCH, as a string.

url.description: The full request URL including any query string, e.g. https://x402fi.dev/g/stockfi-trade/v1/preflight?symbol=AAPL

name: get_payment_requirements
title: Get the x402 payment requirements for a request
